summary: Father and daughter reported missing on Missouri Peak; SARDOC dog teams assisted Chaffee County SAR on a three-day search (June 30-July 2); the pair was located by helicopter, uninjured.
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue; SARDOC
notes: Mission ran 2011-06-30 to 07-02; date is mission start. SARDOC public mission-summary PDF (subagent-opened this run).
